units.source_text: 此时云居雁的父亲新太政大臣退朝，道经三条院，望见院内红叶如锦，不胜依恋，便停车过访。

en.t: At this time, Kumoi no Kari's father, the new Grand Minister, was returning from court when his route took him past Sanjo-in. Seeing the maple leaves in the grounds glowing like brocade, he could not bear to pass by, so he stopped his carriage and paid a visit.

units.source_text: 但见院内景象，较之太君在世之时无甚变迁，处处窗明几净，宜于居住。

en.t: Inside, he found that the estate had changed little since the Grand Lady had been alive; everywhere the windows were bright, the tables clean, and the place was pleasant to live in.

units.source_text: 太政大臣抚今追昔，深为感慨。

en.t: The Grand Minister looked at the present and thought back to the past, and was deeply overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 夕雾中纳言亦觉心情异样，脸上略泛红晕，态度更加沉静了。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Yugiri also felt strangely moved; a faint blush rose on his face, and his manner grew still more composed.

units.source_text: 他与云居雁真是一对天成佳偶。

en.t: He and Kumoi no Kari were truly a match made in heaven.

units.source_text: 云居雁不能说是盖世无双的美人；

en.t: Kumoi no Kari could not be called a peerless beauty;

units.source_text: 但夕雾确有无限清丽之相。

en.t: but Yugiri certainly possessed an endlessly clear and graceful beauty.

units.source_text: 老侍女们在新夫妇身边十分得意，竞将陈年旧事讲给他们听。

en.t: The elderly gentlewomen, delighted to be beside the newlyweds, eagerly competed to tell them old stories from long ago.

units.source_text: 太政大臣看见两人咏诗的稿纸散置在旁，拿来一读，也伤心起来，说道：

en.t: The Grand Minister saw the sheets on which the two had written poems lying scattered nearby. He picked them up and read them, then grew sorrowful too, and said:

units.source_text: “我也想向这泉水探问太君的消息呢。

en.t: "I too would like to ask this spring water for news of the Grand Lady.

units.source_text: 只恐老人多感，出言不祥耳。”

en.t: I only fear that an old man is too easily moved and may utter words of ill omen."
